subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**among**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**among**" is used when referring to more than two people or things within a group. (के बीच में)
 
• In this context, we are talking about literacy rates within the group of young women, making "**among**" the most appropriate choice.
 
• "**Between**" is used for two distinct items, which is not applicable here.
 
• "**Over**" refers to a position or period of time and doesn’t suit the relational context of the sentence.
 
• "**Against**" is used to express opposition or contrast, which is irrelevant in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Updated Passage (till blank 2): *Worldwide illiteracy rates have **consistently**__ declined in the last few decades. One of the major reasons for this decline is the sharp increase in literacy rates __**among**__ young women...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Between** (के बीच): Used for two distinct people or things.

 **Example:** The discussion between the two leaders was fruitful.
 
• **Over** (ऊपर): Indicates a position or span of time.

 **Example:** The project was completed over two months.
 
• **Against** (के खिलाफ): Indicates resistance or opposition.

 **Example:** She stood firmly against injustice.
